<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" width="830" style="width: 622pt;"><tbody><tr height="192" style="height:144.0pt">
  <td height="192" class="xl63" width="830" style="height:144.0pt;width:622pt"><p>Notwithstanding
  the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted
  Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking and re-enacting that
  Order with or without modification), no fencing or walls, which would
  sub-divide the site and separate the outbuilding hereby approved from the
  residential curtilage of the main dwelling, shall be constructed without
  planning permission first obtained from the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>Reason:&nbsp;To safeguard the amenities of neighbouring residents, to prevent the unauthorised introduction of an independent use and to ensure compliance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.1 &amp; D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.</p></td></tr></tbody></table>

Matching Materials - The facing materials used in the development hereby permitted shall match those of the existing building in materials, style, colour, texture and, in the case of brickwork, bonding, coursing and pointing.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
description: ERECTION OF SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION, FIRST FLOOR FRONT EXTENSION WITH DUAL PITCHED ROOF AND FRONT PORCH AND OUTBUILDING IN FRONT GARDEN FOR ANCILLARY USE
